--------                                                                    
                                                                              
  **@pierre** wrote on 2026-10-24 17:10:                                      
                                                                              
  Implementation plan: user-selected opt-in FIR accuracy mode. Add structural 
  accuracy_mode bool (serde/default false) without changing the four manual   
  FIR choices, their 0..3 indices/default, or normalized automation. Preserve 
  the stored manual length while accuracy mode resolves actual support        
  independently. Append its external flattened automation address after all   
  legacy globals/band slots; keep canonical metadata, core cached             
  params/getters/setters, bridge/FFI/NIH state reconstruction and engine      
  settings/converter consistent. No custom UI work.                           
                                                                              
  On the existing fallible from_params construction path, try                 
  1024/2048/4096/8192 in order. Qualify final f32 FIR coefficients after      
  selected linear/minimum-phase generation, centered-symmetry handling and    
  AutoGain. Use an independent bilinear analog-prototype target (not designer 
  interpolation/biquad coefficients). Declare a sampled full DC–Nyquist       
  response criterion: at least 32x zero-padding (minimum FFT length32768),    
  plus log-spaced points and natural per-band center/Q transition features    
  evaluated by direct f64 DTFT. No audit probe list is an optimizer/selection 
  input and no continuous-frequency certification is claimed.                 
                                                                              
  Null policy is explicit residual-based, not clipping both magnitudes:       
  require |actual_magnitude-target_magnitude| <= (1-10^(-                     
  0.05/20))*max(target_magnitude,1e-4). This conservatively implies <=0.05 dB 
  magnitude error above the -80 dB reference floor; below it the absolute     
  residual limit is approximately5.74e-7 amplitude. Check all stages and the  
  full ordered 2x2 channel-domain cascade (plus unpaired path) with actual    
  complex stage responses; minimum-phase ideal stages use the corresponding   
  analytic complex prototype, linear-phase ideal stages use positive          
  magnitudes with the common declared delay removed. AutoGain target reference
  follows ideal meaningful DC, else meaningful Nyquist, else unchanged, so    
  actual finite-FIR normalization cannot hide response error. Existing        
  unsupported placed-band AutoGain remains rejected. If8192 fails, return a   
  clear accuracy failure with no tolerance relaxation or silent fallback.     
                                                                              
  Expose resolved selected taps, sampled error/qualification scope and full   
  actual route latency before audio; fixed helper                             
  linear_phase_eq_latency_samples retains its fixed-only contract. Live       
  snapshots carry accuracy mode plus actual selected length. Off-thread       
  dynamic preparation validates the full proposed target at that fixed        
  selected support and refuses with an explicit rebuild/reprepare message when
  it cannot qualify; no hidden latency change and realtime commit stays       
  allocation-free. Real sample-rate changes in accuracy mode require          
  structural reconstruction/refuse before mutation; reset/same-rate           
  initialization preserve selection. Manual modes retain existing behavior and
  FIR-M1 historical fixed1024 failure/bound remains intact.                   
                                                                              
  Validation: independent prototype/streamed impulse checks of selected f32   
  response for both phases, shortest-selection proof by checking shorter      
  supported lengths, high-Q low-band max-support refusal, explicit near-null  
  policy, AutoGain references, stereo/placed/M/S cascades and total latency,  
  reset/same-rate handling, failed-rate-change immutability, accepted/rejected
  dynamic updates at fixed latency, old presets/defaults/numeric and          
  normalized automation IDs, canonical/schema/factory state and structural    
  setters, zero heap in affected commit/render paths. Run affected            
  suites/strict Clippy; retain full-load limitations and no performance       
  timing. Preserve unrelated staged/user engine/driver changes and commit only
  exact owned paths.
